name: stockridge
author: StockRidge
description: StockRidge inventory, POS and back-office — one Worker/Turso backend with PWA, Electron and Android clients

scripts.worker:deploy: npm run check && wrangler deploy --env "" --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.electron:build: npm run check && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run check && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --win dir --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run check && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --linux AppImage
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run check && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --mac zip dmg
scripts.android:build: npm run check && node tools/android-build.js debug
scripts.android:build:release: npm run check && node tools/android-build.js release
scripts.android:install: npm run android:build && node tools/adb-run.js install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
